style.backgroundSystem: flat light grounds on #FFFFFF and #F2F3F5; hero and trust screens on flat muted green walls #7EC4BC and #7C8A66; dark mood and comparison cards on deep forest green #16352A; real home interiors (living room, bedroom) for scene shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons with short rounded info chips in #7EC4BC or #FFFFFF
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows on light screens; controlled low-key lighting with a single glow accent on dark mood cards; 5500K natural window light for interior scenes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-tone premium home-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of crisp white #FFFFFF, light neutral grey #F2F3F5, deep forest green #16352A and one fresh teal accent #7EC4BC with charcoal text #33383D; bright soft diffused lighting with soft contact shadows on light screens and controlled low-key lighting with a single glow accent on dark mood cards; modern geometric sans-serif type; consistent rounded info chips and thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the wall-mounted unit always level, centered and at stable scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented energy grades or certification marks
style.presentationRules: the wall-mounted unit always level, centered and at stable scale; interior scenes keep the product in the upper third of the wall; no angle drift between scenes of the same room; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte painted interior walls, soft fabric upholstery, light wood accents
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type, #33383D text on light grounds and #FFFFFF text on dark grounds
